name: Everyday Pantry
summary: Fruit, water, milk, eggs, seeds and staples found in homes all over the world.

foods.name: Glass of Water
foods.blurb: Plain water. The best drink for thinking, playing and cooling down.

foods.name: Banana
foods.blurb: Nature's energy bar. Quick fuel plus potassium for muscles.

foods.name: Apple
foods.blurb: Crunchy, juicy and full of fiber.

foods.name: Orange
foods.blurb: Juicy segments of vitamin C to fight germs.

foods.name: Guava
foods.blurb: One guava has more vitamin C than four oranges!

foods.name: Carrot Sticks
foods.blurb: Crunchy orange sticks for sharp eyes.

foods.name: Cucumber Slices
foods.blurb: Cool, crunchy and almost all water.

foods.name: Warm Milk
foods.blurb: Builds bones and teeth.

foods.name: Bowl of Yogurt
foods.blurb: Plain yogurt (curd) full of friendly tummy bacteria.

foods.name: Roasted Chickpeas
foods.blurb: Crunchy roasted chickpeas. A protein-packed pocket snack.

foods.name: Pumpkin Seeds
foods.blurb: Tiny green seeds with big calm-and-shield powers.

foods.name: Dates
foods.blurb: Naturally sweet energy with a little iron.

foods.name: Spinach
foods.blurb: Leafy greens: iron for focus and vitamin A for eyes.

foods.name: Boiled Egg
foods.blurb: A perfect little package of protein.

foods.name: Roasted Sweet Potato
foods.blurb: Roasted until soft. Sweet, slow energy.

foods.name: Bowl of Oats
foods.blurb: Warm oats: slow energy that lasts all morning.

foods.name: Packet Chips
foods.blurb: Salty and crunchy, but mostly oil and salt.

foods.name: Fizzy Cola
foods.blurb: Lots of sugar bubbles. A quick zoom, then a big crash.

foods.name: Candy
foods.blurb: Sticky sugar that stays on your teeth.

foods.name: Instant Noodles
foods.blurb: Quick to cook, but low on the good stuff and high in salt.

foods.name: Cream Biscuits
foods.blurb: Sweet and tasty, but mostly sugar and flour.

foods.name: Ice Cream
foods.blurb: A cold treat for special days.

foods.name: Sugary Cereal
foods.blurb: Bright and crunchy, but mostly sugar.

foods.name: French Fries
foods.blurb: Deep-fried and delicious. Perfect for a party, not for a mission.

foods.name: Birthday Cake
foods.blurb: For birthdays! Lots of sugar and butter.

foods.name: Peanut Brittle
foods.blurb: Crunchy peanuts in hard candy. Yummy, but very sticky and sweet.
